_doc: Source of truth for Ultrastable's positioning and memory rule. Prose elsewhere is generated or checked against this file: `python3 -m foundation doctrine --apply` injects the line into the markdown files listed under `inject`, `--check` (run by checks.yml and the tests) fails when any listed file lacks it or states a contradiction, and gaplint rules GL008 and GL009 read this file. Changed only by a reviewed PR.
tagline: Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.

licensing.decision: 2026-11-11 (Rowan): no patent. Source-available hybrid license: free for non-commercial use, a Commercial License with revenue share for any commercial use. Specs live in ultrastable/spec and replace the patent drafts; the patent drafts are archived in ip/.
required_patterns: COMMERCIAL USE REQUIRES A COMMERCIAL LICENSE

memory.rule: Code is the only memory. All project state lives in this repository (docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md and data files). No agent relies on chat, tool or platform memory; a thread is never the only record.

runs_on_itself._doc: Self-reference is the proof. Ultrastable runs its own planning, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget, specs, release and reporting with the code it gives everyone else. `python3 -m foundation selfhost --verify` fails when any of it depends on a tool with no recorded adapter; `foundation doctrine --check` runs that verifier and fails when a listed file lacks the line.
runs_on_itself.line: Ultrastable runs on itself: its roadmap, issues, managers, trust ledger, plussing budget and specs are run by the same code it gives everyone else, from this repository alone, with any tools (`python3 -m foundation selfhost`).
contradictions: ultrastable (does not|doesn't|will not|won't) run on itself
runs_on_itself._public_note: Public and SAFE NOW files carry only the short tagline, never the mechanism line; they are check_only and edited by hand.

loops_thesis: Vibe coding is a start, not a system. A system is many agents with separate duties, running code loops that check, report and improve themselves. Ultrastable is built that way: multi-agent, self-referential loops, not a prompt and not a single code agent.
